source.name: 2Playbook: Saski Baskonia renueva a Kosner como ‘title sponsor’ hasta la temporada 2027-2028
source.quote: seguirá siendo title sponsor del club hasta el final de la temporada 2027-2028
source.note: Naming sponsor ('Kosner Baskonia') since November 2025, first as title sponsor to the end of 2025-26, renewed on 9 September 2026 to 2027-28 with front-of-shirt presence; the collaboration also includes front-of-shirt presence per Kosner's own announcement (kosner.es, 9 Sep 2026). Value not disclosed.

note: Naming sponsor since November 2025 (Kosner Baskonia); renewed to 2027-28 in September 2026.
